metadata.question: In September 2023, did Cabo Frio have a sea zone of a temperature graident over 5 degrees Celcius over less than 10 kilometers?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about sea surface temperature gradients in Cabo Frio in September 2023. Specifically, they want to know if there was a zone where temperature changed by more than 5°C over less than 10km. For this analysis, I need to: 1. Use sea surface temperature (SST) data - MODIS or VIIRS would be good options 2. Calculate temperature gradients over the region 3. Check if any gradients exceed 5°C/10km (which is 0.5°C/km) 4. Focus on Cabo Frio region in Brazil I'll use MODIS Ocean Color SST data which has good spatial resolution (~1km) for detecting gradients. I'll compute the gradient magnitude and check if it exceeds the threshold. Let me structure this: - Geometry: Point around Cabo Frio with a buffer to cover the coastal area - Data: MODIS SST for September 2023 - Processing: Calculate gradient magnitude, check for values > 0.5°C/km - Validation: Check for valid pixels and reasonable results I need to handle the cases: - C1: No SST data available - C2: No valid pixels after masking - C3: Invalid calculations - A/B: Yes/No based on whether gradient threshold is exceeded ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const caboFrio = ee.Geometry.Point([-42.018, -22.878]); const region = caboFrio.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Cabo Frio const startDate = '2023-09-01'; const endDate = '2023-09-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Ocean SST const sstCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region) .select('sst'); const colSize = sstCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`September 2023 SST Images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composite to reduce cloud effects const sstComposite = sstCol.median(); // 3. Calculate temperature gradient // Gradient magnitude = sqrt((dx)^2 + (dy)^2) in °C per degree // Convert to °C/km (approx 0.00899° per km at this latitude) const gradient = sstComposite.gradient(); const gradMagnitude = gradient.select('sst_x').pow(2) .add(gradient.select('sst_y').pow(2)) .sqrt() .multiply(111.32); // Convert to °C/km (approx conversion) // 4. Check for gradients > 0.5°C/km (5°C/10km) const strongGradient = gradMagnitude.gt(0.5); // Count valid pixels and strong gradient pixels const stats = strongGradient.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.sum(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const totalPixels = stats.get('count').getInfo(); const strongGradPixels = stats.get('sum').getInfo(); console.log(`Total valid SST pixels: ${totalPixels}`); console.log(`Pixels with gradient >5°C/10km: ${strongGradPixels}`); if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check if result is valid if (strongGradPixels === null || strongGradPixels === undefined || isNaN(strongGradPixels) || strongGradPixels < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final determination const gradientPercentage = (strongGradPixels / totalPixels) * 100; console.log(`Strong gradient coverage: ${gradientPercentage.toFixed(2)}%`); if (strongGradPixels > 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
